issue.title: BOM-prefixed album notes are never registered as albums
issue.description: Proposed by bob-cli-o6.3 (note #5, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP) and triaged by the bob-cli-o6 land agent. projects::parse_frontmatter requires line 1 to be exactly '---', so an album file that starts with a UTF-8 BOM is never registered: bob albums tidy/sync/list never see it. The tidy planner itself preserves BOM bytes (unit-tested); only discovery needs to strip the BOM first. Pre-existing; no live album has a BOM today. Precedent: bob-cli-kf.4 made the bank month-note parser read frontmatter from BOM-stripped text.

task_type_fields.impact: A BOM-saved album silently drops out of every album reader, index, and tidy pass
task_type_fields.repro: Prepend EF BB BF to a valid album note; bob albums list no longer shows it and tidy/sync skip it

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-o6.3 note #5 found album discovery rejects a UTF-8 BOM before the frontmatter fence; filed by the bob-cli-o6 land agent as a latent discovery gap.

payload.entry: Props landing source audit at 3e480e4a: resolve_note_context calls projects::parse_frontmatter on raw Markdown, so this BOM gap now downgrades a valid BOM-prefixed album/reference/project to note even though PropsDocument parses it. Generic props must preserve ownership or refuse unresolved edits. The props landing repair plan will handle that boundary and coordinate any shared parser change here; this is new unsafe integration impact, not a claimed runtime reproduction.
